message:
fix(lcd): rotate complete display by 180 degrees

at the top and A at the bottom. Enable rotation only in the main touch-game
display; preserve LCD timing, audio, touch input and project constraints.

Include two focused LCD simulations, build receipts and the verified FS
release package. Hardware panel validation remains pending.
